title: Agent Chat Response (v2)
description: Response body for POST /api/v2/chat. Simplified envelope: 'content' replaces the v1 'response' field.

authorization_required.description: Validated opaque target-authorization challenge; never execution authority. The requester must explicitly start a new turn after authorization.

structured_output.description: Validated structured output when the request carried a response_schema (SPEC-017 R-2); null when the turn produced none.

model.description: Model id that resolved for this turn (SPEC-024 R-3/R-4); null when no model is configured.
